subtitle.chooseModelType: Choose a model type to get started

actions.switchWarning: Save or discard changes before switching tabs.

tabs.yamlDescription: Edit the YAML directly. The model name must be set in the YAML for create to work.

modelName.label: Model Name
modelName.hint: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and dots only.

empty.nav: Use the search bar above to add fields
empty.title: No fields configured
empty.text: Use the search bar above to find and add configuration fields.

proxyVision.label: This model can look at images
proxyVision.hint: Turn this on when the upstream model accepts images. LocalAI cannot check it. Attached images then go to the model with the message.

engineSettings.title: Runtime tuning
engineSettings.leadNoCommand: How {{engine}} loads and runs this model. An empty field keeps the default.

hints.load_mode: How the model file is read. Writes mmap, mmlock and the direct_io option.
hints.backend_sampling: Where the next token is picked: on the CPU or on the GPU.

errors.colon: A colon cuts the value short. Remove it.
errors.empty: Type an entry, or remove the row.
errors.rawOwned: {{name}} is set by a field above. Use that field.
errors.layerRange: Each range needs a start and an end layer, with the end not before the start.
errors.overrideTarget: The buffer name can only have letters, digits and underscores: {{target}}
errors.overrideRegex: This pattern is not a valid regular expression: {{entry}}

placement.title: Tensor placement

modes.rest: First N layers on GPU, experts of the rest on CPU
modes.ranges: Experts of chosen layers on CPU

help.experts: Keeps the expert weights of every layer in system memory. The rest of the model stays on the GPU.
help.rest: Keeps the first N layers on the GPU and the experts of every later layer on the CPU. With the total number of layers, the pattern lists the rest as one range.
help.ranges: Keeps the experts of the layers you choose in system memory, for example 0-6 and 18-23.
help.raw: Writes the value as you type it.

placement.gpuLayers: Layers with experts on the GPU
placement.failed: The server could not build the pattern: {{message}}

bigMoe.name: Big MoE on a small GPU
bigMoe.text: All layers on the GPU, experts on the CPU, 8-bit KV cache.

maxContext.name: Max context
maxContext.text: 128K context, flash attention and an 8-bit KV cache.

lowVram.name: Low VRAM
lowVram.text: 4K context, a 4-bit KV cache and a small micro-batch.

applied.title: {{name}}: {{count}} settings changed.
applied.none: Nothing changed. The form already had these values.
applied.note: The fields stay editable. Nothing is saved until you save the model.

raw.title: Advanced options
raw.hint: Other entries of the options list, one per row: name:value, or a {{binary}} flag such as --flag:value.

preview.title: Command preview
preview.note: The {{binary}} command these settings match. LocalAI starts the backend itself; this line is for comparison and for use outside LocalAI.

paste.title: Paste a {{binary}} command
paste.hint: Flags with a field fill that field. Flags with no field are kept as raw options and listed below.
paste.failed: The command could not be read.
paste.modelFile: The command uses the model file {{file}}.
paste.modelFileKept: This model keeps {{file}} until you choose otherwise.
paste.unmappedNote: A flag with no field is kept as a raw option and passed to {{engine}} as written. Remove the ones you do not want.

schemaError.title: Runtime tuning is not available.
schemaError.body: The server did not send the {{engine}} settings ({{message}}). You can still edit every setting as text in the other tab of this editor.

readOnly.title: Read only.
readOnly.body: Only an administrator can change these settings.

quick.title: Quick setup
quick.approximate: Rough estimates: the model layout was not read from the file.
quick.failed: The memory estimate is not available.
quick.tight: The f16 KV cache does not fit, so this uses an 8-bit one.
quick.shared: The slots share one KV cache, so more streams need about the same memory: each stream gets a smaller part of the context.
quick.nowShort: KV cache ≈ {{kv}}, compute buffers ≈ {{compute}}, at {{context}} tokens

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.text: The default batch sizes: LocalAI picks them for your GPU.
balanced.line: Batch sizes that LocalAI picks for your GPU.

longPrompts.name: Long prompts
longPrompts.text: A batch of 2048. Long prompts are read much faster; the compute buffers use more memory.

memory.discrete: The micro-batch is 1024 on a discrete GPU: its compute buffer must fit one card.

longPrompts.line: Reads long prompts much faster. Uses more memory.

concurrencyDefault.name: Default
concurrencyDefault.text: LocalAI picks the slots for your GPU and the backend uses its serving defaults.
concurrencyDefault.line: For one person or a few. LocalAI picks the slots.

streams8.name: 8 streams
streams8.text: 8 slots with paged serving: requests share the KV cache and wait instead of failing when it is full.
streams8.bestFor: A team chatting with one model.
streams8.line: For a team chatting with one model.

streams16.name: 16 streams
streams16.text: 16 slots, GPU sampling when 16 requests run, no drafting.
streams16.bestFor: Agents and tools that send requests in parallel.

memory.system: No GPU: tokens are sampled on the CPU.

streams16.line: For agents and tools that send requests in parallel.

streams32.name: 32+ streams
streams32.text: 32 slots with GPU sampling always on and no drafting: the most tokens per second in total, each stream slower.
streams32.bestFor: Batch jobs and many users at once.

memory.discrete: 8-bit KV cache: about twice the tokens fit, at a small cost in quality and speed.
memory.system: Not offered without a GPU: a CPU shared by 32 streams makes each one too slow.

streams32.line: For batch jobs and many users. Most tokens per second in total.

backend_sampling.off: Sample tokens on the CPU. Nothing is written to the file.
backend_sampling.auto: Use GPU sampling when the model runs on a GPU with several parallel requests and the request does not need grammar or logprobs.
backend_sampling.on: Sample tokens on the GPU. Faster with many parallel requests. Turned off automatically for requests that use a grammar, a reasoning budget or logprobs.

load_mode.default: llama.cpp picks: memory-mapped, except on integrated GPUs that would hold the model twice.

drafting.title: Drafting (speculative decoding)
drafting.lead: A fast drafter proposes the next tokens and the model checks them in one step. Answers come faster; the output stays the same.
drafting.auto: {{mode}} is on by default: this model has an MTP head, so LocalAI drafts with it unless you choose Off.

custom.title: Custom drafting setup
custom.body: This model uses spec_type {{kinds}}, which none of the modes covers. It stays as it is until you pick a mode.

off.label: Off
off.doc: No drafting. Every token comes from the model alone.

ngram.label: N-gram
ngram.doc: Proposes the tokens that followed the same words earlier in the conversation. No extra model and no extra memory.
ngram.note: Best for output that repeats its input, such as code edits or long quotes. On normal chat it gains little and can cost a few percent.

model.label: Draft model
model.doc: A small model with the same vocabulary proposes tokens, and the model checks them in one step.
model.note: The draft model is loaded beside the model and uses its own memory.

mtp.label: MTP
mtp.doc: The model's own multi-token prediction head proposes the next tokens. No second model to load.

options_spec_ngram_mod_n_min.label: Draft tokens, at least
options_spec_ngram_mod_n_min.hint: Fewest tokens a match must propose before it is used.

options_spec_ngram_mod_n_max.label: Draft tokens, at most
options_spec_ngram_mod_n_max.hint: Most tokens proposed after a match.

options_spec_ngram_mod_n_match.label: Match length
options_spec_ngram_mod_n_match.hint: Tokens that must match an earlier passage before it is copied.

options_spec_n_min.label: Draft tokens, at least
options_spec_n_min.hint: Fewest drafted tokens worth checking. 0 checks any draft.

options_spec_n_max.label: Draft tokens, at most
options_spec_n_max.hint: Most tokens the draft model proposes per step. More helps only when it guesses well.

options_spec_p_min.label: Acceptance threshold
options_spec_p_min.hint: The draft model stops a draft when it is less sure than this, from 0 to 1.

options_spec_n_max.label: Draft tokens, at most
options_spec_n_max.hint: Most tokens the MTP head proposes per step.

options_spec_p_min.label: Acceptance threshold
options_spec_p_min.hint: The head stops a draft when it is less sure than this, from 0 to 1.

streams.label: Pause drafting above N streams
streams.hint: Drafting pauses while more requests than this generate at once, and resumes when the load drops. 0 never pauses.

picker.label: Draft model
picker.hint: A small model of the same family, such as a 0.6B or 1B model.
picker.empty: No other model that {{engine}} runs is installed. Install a small model of the same family first.
picker.noFile: {{name}} has no model file to use as a draft.
picker.failed: The installed models could not be listed.

fit.title: Compatibility
fit.mismatchText: The vocabularies differ ({{main}} and {{draft}} tokens). llama.cpp refuses this pair, so the model fails to load.
fit.familyText: Both are {{family}} models. The vocabulary could not be read to confirm it.
fit.unknownText: The vocabularies could not be compared. The draft must use the same tokenizer as the model.
fit.unmatched: The file is not an installed model, so it cannot be checked.

memory.title: Memory
memory.split: ({{weights}} weights and {{kv}} KV cache at {{context}} tokens).
memory.unmatched: No estimate: expect about the file's size plus a KV cache as large as the model's context.

memory.label: Memory type
memory.unknown: Memory type not detected: using the {{kind}} rules

unified.label: Unified memory
unified.doc: The GPU shares the system memory (DGX Spark, Jetson, Apple silicon, AMD APUs). More slots fit; the prompt cache and checkpoints are kept small because they use the same memory.

discrete.label: Discrete GPU
discrete.doc: The GPU has its own memory. Slots are capped by the VRAM estimate, 32 streams use an 8-bit KV cache, and the prompt cache stays in system memory.

system.label: No GPU
system.doc: The model runs on the CPU in system memory. The caches are kept small, and 32 streams are not offered.

advice.unifiedLoadMode: On unified memory, a memory-mapped model is held twice while it loads. Default loads it once.
